اخترعتا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَعَتَا (iḵtaraʕatā) /ix.ta.ra.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# اُخْتُرِعَتَا (uḵturiʕatā) /ux.tu.ri.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
